title: The price impact of order book events
finding: OFI uses changes in best bid/ask prices and displayed queue sizes; trade imbalance is a distinct variable. This is a contemporaneous price-impact comparison on US equity data, not evidence of future crypto returns.

surface: Official IAB / historical trades / field description
finding: The visible archive help labels side as buy/sell transaction direction, size as traded quantity, created_time as Unix milliseconds, and source as ordinary versus retail price improvement orders. It does not explicitly say aggressor/taker.
Catalog separately offers trade and L2 history. A catalog listing is not verified acquisition or complete event coverage.
